findings.title: Comment claims nothing else waits on _outgoing_queue_ready after swap, but…
findings.claim: The comment states that nothing else waits on _outgoing_queue_ready after the swap, but stop_send_loop() still waits on it at line 225.

findings.title: Test scaffolding is clumsy: unused parameter, const_cast hack, excessive fixture code
findings.claim: The test scaffolding has an unused is_server parameter, uses a const_cast to mutate hooks, and includes about 130 lines of fixtures for a single test.

findings.title: New doxygen comment placed above stale plain comment; PR body has unrelated…
findings.claim: The new doxygen comment sits above the existing plain "// send data Out..." comment, and the PR body carries a Claude Code attribution line plus issue and Jira references that belong to other trackers.

findings.title: Regression test doesn't actually fail if late send_empty_frame() is accepted; relies on…
findings.claim: The regression test doesn't fail if the late send_empty_frame() is accepted, and it depends on a fixed 10-yield window, making its claimed determinism weak.

findings.title: stream_close() swallows queue-drain failure and closes the write buffer anyway
findings.claim: stream_close() swallows a queue-drain failure and proceeds to close the write buffer regardless.

findings.title: _stream_closing guard only applied in send(), bypassed by other code enqueuing onto…
findings.claim: The new _stream_closing guard is only checked in send(); other code paths that enqueue onto _outgoing_queue bypass this guard.

findings.title: Documentation doesn't clarify that dropping an unclosed sink causes a process-aborting…
findings.claim: The statement "Dropping an unclosed sink is an error" doesn't specify that it is actually an assertion that aborts the process.
